name: English - English for Architects C1
description: This course is tailored to the needs of architecture students planning a semester abroad or overseas work experience. It will deal with expanding architectural vocabulary, reviewing grammar, and developing communicative abilities for professional and academic situations.
prerequisites:
This is a C1 level course and you need to complete the placement test before the first lesson (bring a printout of your result!).
If your result does not reach this standard, you should consider refreshing your English in another course first. English for Architects runs every semester!
